_about: Per-part notes for Board Boxes Info mode. Matched by full reference designator. Lookup order: the board's variant list first (lean or guard), then shared. Each entry: purpose (what the part does in this circuit) and issues (possible current problems, with the source in docs/slave-18s-design-basis.md or site/news.html). Edit here, not in app.js. Re-run export_site.py after editing so the hosted snapshot picks it up.

shared.purpose: V+ filter capacitor, 100 nF 100 V, from the chip's V+ pin (VP_F) to V-. The 100 nF of Figure 112's V+ filter, with R301 in front of it.
Collector capacitor for the regulator NPN, 100 nF 100 V, from the collector (VCOLL) to V-. The datasheet text value; Figure 112 shows 10 nF (deviation 6).
VREG decoupling, 1 uF from the 5 V regulator output (VREG) to V-. Figure 112 value.
Reference decoupling, 1 uF from VREF1 or VREF2 to V-. Figure 112 value.

isoSPI centre-tap capacitor, 10 nF to V-. Racc's filtering for motor noise (deviation 1): the midpoint of the split termination (ISOx_CM) and the transformer's chip-side centre tap (ISOx_CT) each get one.
issues: The datasheet warns that centre-tap caps above 10 nF can stop the isoSPI common mode settling. Do not raise them.

shared.purpose: isoSPI termination half, 51 ohm. Two in series make the split 100 ohm termination, with the midpoint on ISOx_CM (Racc's filter point, deviation 1).
Bias divider, 1 kohm: IBIAS to ICMP. Part of the IBIAS-1k-ICMP-1k-V- network from Figure 112.
Bias divider, 1 kohm: ICMP to V-. Second half of the IBIAS/ICMP network from Figure 112.
100 kohm pull-up from thermistor input GPIO1 to GPIO4 up to VREF2. Racc's thermistor arrangement (deviation 3).
100 nF from thermistor input GPIO1 to GPIO4 to V-: the NTC filter (deviation 3).
On-board 100 kohm NTC on GPIO4 to V-, measures board temperature.
Cell tap connector C0 to C9, 10-pin JST PH 2 mm. Pin 1 is C0 (V-); pin n is C(n-1).
issues: The harness must match the Funwheel pack's tap order (open item).

shared.purpose: Cell tap connector C9 to C18, 10-pin JST PH 2 mm. Pin 1 is C9, pin 10 is C18 (top of stack). C9 is on both J1 and J5 by design.
issues: Both plugs carry the same C9 tap. The harness must not wire C9 twice with different wires.

shared.purpose: NTC connector, 6-pin JST PH: GPIO1 to GPIO3 and V- for the external cell NTCs.
issues: The harness must match the Funwheel pack's NTC wiring (open item).

shared.purpose: isoSPI port connector, JST GH 2-pin top entry (BM02B-GHS-TBT). J3 is port A in, J4 is port B out. The same family as the ENNOID master, so its cable plugs straight in.
issues: Review item 03: is soldering through the JST pin holes a sound joint on a carrier, and how do the ports reach it?

shared.purpose: ADBMS1818 cell monitor, LQFP-64 with an exposed pad tied to V-. Reads the 18 cell voltages through the C-pin inputs, balances through the S pins and talks isoSPI.
issues: Exposed pad: 16 open 0.2 mm plated holes. The assembler must accept the paste and voiding, or choose via-fill (review item 08).
The die's thermal budget with every cell balancing is not confirmed (open item).

shared.purpose: Regulator NPN (FZT853, SOT-223). It takes the stack down to the 5 V VREG rail. DRIVE sets its base current and the collector sits on VCOLL.
issues: Heat: the collector needs a large copper area on both layers, stitched. The estimate is about 1.07 W on Lean at 75.6 V (open item).
Stock was thin (264) at the last check. Recheck before ordering.

shared.purpose: Mounting hole in the corner of the board.

lean.purpose: 100 nF from thermistor input GPIO1 to V-: the NTC filter (deviation 3).
issues: GPIO1 is the longest net on Lean, about 50 mm on an inner layer (review item 02 area).

lean.purpose: 10 ohm series resistor, 0402, between cell 0 (CELL0) and the chip's C0 pin. Figure 112 part; it also carries the balance return current of cell 1.
issues: C0_F carries the cell 1 balance return (about 31 mA while balancing) on a 48 mm inner-layer run (review item 02).

lean.purpose: 10 ohm series resistor, 0402, between cell n's tap (CELLn) and the chip's Cn pin. Figure 112 part; it also carries the balance return current of the next cell.
issues: Lean has no per-pin 100 nF filter capacitors (C101 to C118 are Guard only; Racc's board has none), so these resistors have no capacitor after them.

lean.purpose: Balance resistor for cell n, from the cell node (CELLn) to S n. Turns on to bleed that cell while balancing.
issues: 120 ohm gives about 30 mA per cell, against about 89 mA with Guard's 33 ohm, so balancing is slower. All 18 at once is about 2.3 W in total (estimate).

lean.purpose: V+ filter resistor, 100 ohm 0603, from the top of the stack (CELL18) to the chip's V+ pin (VP_F). Figure 112's 100 ohm V+ filter, with C301.
Lean only: 1 kohm 2512 1 W collector resistor from CELL18 to VCOLL. It replaces the datasheet's 100 ohm so that Q301 dissipates less (deviation 14).
issues: Estimated 0.48 W at 22 mA and 1.23 W at the 35 mA peak, against a 1 W rating. The pulse rating and the master's duty cycle are not yet known (open item).
Below about 41 V on the stack at 35 mA, the collector falls under the datasheet's 6 V minimum.

lean.purpose: Collector capacitor for the regulator NPN, 100 nF 100 V, from VCOLL to V-. The datasheet text value (deviation 6).
issues: With the 1 kohm R302 the RC corner is about 1.6 kHz instead of 16 kHz (design basis).

lean.purpose: isoSPI transformer for port A, Bourns SM91502AL on Lean: common-mode choke built in, 1000 VDC working. It isolates the chip's port A pair from the cable.
issues: Port A's chip-side pair runs 26 to 33 mm on an inner layer (review item 05).
Foreign crossings on this port are uncovered by a shield (review item 06; isospi_shield_check.py finds six in total).

lean.purpose: isoSPI transformer for port B, Bourns SM91502AL on Lean: common-mode choke built in, 1000 VDC working. It isolates the chip's port B pair from the cable.
issues: Foreign crossings on this port are uncovered by a shield (review item 06; isospi_shield_check.py finds six in total).

lean.purpose: Net tie joining CELL0 (the C0 sense wire) to V- at a single point. Lean's replacement for Guard's F120 fuse, so the C0 sense wire stays separate from the V- pour until here.
issues: Deliberate: DRC flags any other copper that joins CELL0 to ground.

lean.purpose: M2 mounting hole in the corner of the board (Lean uses M2; Guard uses M3).
issues: Hole positions and the copper keep-out (2.75 mm from centre for a 5 mm washer) are estimates.

guard.purpose: Guard: 100 ohm 0805 collector resistor from VBAT_F to VCOLL, the datasheet value.
issues: At 75.6 V the NPN dissipates about 1.5 W. The 3 W rating needs 52 x 52 mm of 2 oz copper (open item on the regulator).

guard.purpose: V+ filter resistor, 100 ohm 0603, from the fused supply (VBAT_F) to the chip's V+ pin (VP_F).
Balance resistor for cell n, 33 ohm 2512 1 W, from the cell node to S n.
issues: About 89 mA per cell and 0.26 W each. All 18 at once is about 6.7 W, so firmware should balance odd and even cells in turn. The die budget is open.

guard.purpose: 10 ohm series resistor, 1206, between cell n's tap and the chip's Cn pin. Figure 112 part; it also carries the balance return current of the next cell.
issues: Chosen 1206 because a 0603 would run at about 79 % of its 0.1 W rating while balancing.

guard.purpose: 100 nF 100 V from the C-pin n to V-. The per-pin filter capacitor of Figure 112.
6.8 V zener clamp between neighbouring C pins. Keeps a pair under the chip's 8 V limit, so a plug mated in any order is safe (deviation 8).
250 mA fuse on cell n's tap (CELLn to TAPn). A shorted part or a slipped probe cannot pull pack current through the board (deviation 7).
250 mA supply fuse between the top tap (TAP18) and VBAT_F, so the chip's current does not show up as an error on cells 1 and 18.
250 mA supply fuse from the bottom tap (TAP0) to V-. Lean replaces it with the net tie NT1.
85 V TVS across the supply (VBAT_F to V-), protecting the regulator and chip from a surge (deviation 9).
Unfitted JST PH footprint in parallel with J3 or J4, for a PH header or two soldered wires.
Keystone probe loop for bench access on the net named in its pad. It has no circuit function; Lean removes all of them.
isoSPI transformer with the common-mode choke built in (Pulse HM2113ZNL on Guard). Isolates the chip's isoSPI pair from the cable. T501 is port A, T601 is port B.
M3 mounting hole in the corner of the board.
